responsibility: This file implements GCC’s Go-spec dump facility, which emits Go-language declarations describing C headers and declarations during the build process for libgo/runtime support. It wraps the active debug_hooks so that macro definitions, typedefs, structs, functions, variables, and selected debug declarations are intercepted, queued, and rendered as hidden Go names with translated types, while also tracking macros, keywords, dummy types, and name conflicts. Its responsibility is generation of Go-readable API/type descriptions from GCC debug/declaration streams, not ordinary debug info emission for object files.
